wholeClaimBoundary: These resource-specific applications supplement existing scoped components. No one-case task establishes the complete five-example AI repertoire, full computer vocabulary/readiness, broad historical technology-change claim or a skilled trade qualification. Existing claims, ages, contexts and dependencies remain exact.
learnerState: No learner observations, scores, receipts, mastery inferences or database operations are created.
interpretation: Full means complete prepared source-task design. Accessible elicitation and real saved code/run evidence are still required at delivery; reading a teacher script or passing these repository checks is not pupil attainment.
historicalBoundary: This supplement supersedes only the A2/A2.2 resource conditions in the six dated grade mappings. Historical counts and all unrelated Full/Partial judgments remain historical, not freshly recertified.
